{
  "name": "der-mag-platform-backend",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Backend API dla Cr@ck Platform - system zarządzania zadaniami infrastrukturalnymi",
  "main": "dist/index.js",
  "scripts": {
    "start": "node dist/index.js",
    "dev": "dotenvx run -- nodemon --watch src --exec ts-node src/index.ts",
    "build": "tsc && cp -r public dist/ && cp -r scripts dist/",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit",
    "test": "jest",
    "test:watch": "jest --watch",
    "test:coverage": "jest --coverage",
    "test:unit": "jest --testPathPattern=unit",
    "test:integration": "jest --testPathPattern=integration",
    "migrate:all": "bash scripts/run-all-migrations.sh",
    "migrate:tokens": "psql ${DB_CONNECTION_STRING:-postgresql://${DB_USER}:${DB_PASSWORD}@${DB_HOST}:${DB_PORT}/${DB_NAME}} -f scripts/migrations/20251116_add_refresh_tokens.sql",
    "migrate:materials": "ts-node scripts/migrate-materials.ts",
    "seed:materials": "ts-node scripts/seed-material-stocks.ts",
    "db:setup": "ts-node scripts/setup-database.ts",
    "db:reset": "bash scripts/db-reset.sh",
    "db:drop": "sudo -u postgres psql -c 'DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS ${DB_NAME:-dermag_platform}'",
    "db:create": "sudo -u postgres psql -c 'CREATE DATABASE ${DB_NAME:-dermag_platform}' && sudo -u postgres psql -c 'GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON DATABASE ${DB_NAME:-dermag_platform} TO ${DB_USER:-dermag_user}'",
    "db:backup": "bash scripts/backup-db.sh",
    "db:restore": "bash scripts/restore-db.sh",
    "db:setup-cron": "bash scripts/setup-backup-cron.sh",
    "env:encrypt": "dotenvx encrypt",
    "env:decrypt": "dotenvx decrypt",
    "env:run": "dotenvx run --",
    "env:set": "dotenvx set",
    "env:get": "dotenvx get",
    "audit:production": "npm audit --production",
    "generate-certs": "./scripts/generate-certs.sh",
    "generate-certs:win": "powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/generate-certs.ps1"
  },
  "overrides": {
    "lodash": "^4.17.21",
    "braces": "^3.0.3",
    "tar": "^7.5.3",
    "diff": "^8.0.3",
    "fast-xml-parser": "^5.3.4",
    "minimatch": "^10.0.3",
    "brace-expansion": "^5.0.5",
    "tough-cookie": "^5.1.0",
    "micromatch": "^4.0.8",
    "glob": "^11.0.0"
  },
  "keywords": [
    "der-mag",
    "task-management",
    "infrastructure",
    "api"
  ],
  "author": "Cr@ck",
  "license": "MIT",
  "dependencies": {
    "@types/mssql": "^9.1.9",
    "@types/node-cron": "^3.0.11",
    "@types/uuid": "^10.0.0",
    "bcrypt": "^5.1.1",
    "bull": "^4.16.5",
    "class-transformer": "^0.5.1",
    "class-validator": "^0.14.0",
    "cookie-parser": "^1.4.7",
    "cors": "^2.8.5",
    "csv-parse": "^5.6.0",
    "csv-stringify": "^6.6.0",
    "docxtemplater": "^3.50.0",
    "dotenv": "^16.3.1",
    "exceljs": "^4.4.0",
    "exifr": "^7.1.3",
    "express": "^4.21.0",
    "express-rate-limit": "^7.1.5",
    "handlebars": "^4.7.8",
    "helmet": "^7.1.0",
    "ioredis": "^5.8.2",
    "jsonwebtoken": "^9.0.2",
    "lodash": "^4.17.21",
    "morgan": "^1.10.0",
    "mssql": "^12.2.0",
    "multer": "^1.4.5-lts.1",
    "node-cron": "^4.2.1",
    "nodemailer": "^8.0.4",
    "pdf-lib": "^1.17.1",

    "pizzip": "^3.1.7",

    "sharp": "^0.33.1",

  },
